courses.title: Object Oriented Programming in C++
courses.description: Jeff Yim's lectures and sample code, one module per week. Runnable C++ in every lesson.

modules.title: Week 1
modules.subtitle: program structure, types, operators, casting, constants, console IO
modules.description: Built from the Week 1 slides and sample code (HelloWorld, AddIntegers, assortedOps, bits, const_vs_constexpr, precisionAndWidth, readName). Ends with a mock quiz and a cheat sheet.

modules.title: Week 2
modules.subtitle: file IO, arrays, random numbers, pointers, references, strings, vectors, new/delete
modules.description: Built from the Week 2 slides, the lecture videos and the Pointers and References practice sheet. A step-by-step memory diagram for pointers and references, a file-cursor simulator, and runnable versions of every slide program. Ends with the practice sheet worked, a mock quiz and a cheat sheet.

courses.title: Applied Probability and Statistics
courses.description: Carl Gladish's lecture units and labs, one module per unit. Live statistics calculators and pencil problems with instant checking.

modules.title: Unit 1
modules.subtitle: descriptive statistics
modules.description: Proportions, centre, variation, Z-scores, empirical rule, Chebyshev, quartiles, boxplots, outliers, skewness, correlation. Built from the Unit 1 notes and Lab 1; ends with the pencil problems, a mock quiz and a formula sheet.

modules.title: Unit 2
modules.subtitle: visualizing data, and Lab 2 grouped statistics
modules.description: Frequency tables, pie and bar charts, stem-and-leaf, the histogram class recipe, cumulative relative frequencies and ogives, scatter plots; Lab 2 favstats, model formulas, percentiles, percent ranks and Z-scores on the quine data. Built from the Unit 2 notes (filled) and the Lab 2 solutions; ends with the pencil problems, a mock quiz and a formula sheet.

courses.title: Introduction to Data Communications
courses.description: Marco Ho's lectures and exercise sheets, one module per week. Weekly lab quizzes from Week 2 on the previous weeks; each module ends with a mock quiz and a draft of the one-page study note.

modules.title: Week 1
modules.subtitle: data communications, networks, layering, math review
modules.description: Lectures 01a, 01b, 01c and the Math Review lab, with E01 and the sample quiz worked. Quiz 1 scope (01a) plus the layering half of Quiz 2.

modules.title: Week 2
modules.subtitle: physical layer, data and signals
modules.description: Lecture 02: analog and digital signals, sine waves, phase, wavelength, composite signals and bandwidth, bit rate and levels, with E02 worked. The calculation half of Quiz 2.

courses.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
courses.description: Tom Magliery's lectures, one module per lecture. Pseudocode analysis with live basic-operation counters, and quizzes in the real multiple-choice format; each module ends with a mock quiz and a study sheet.

modules.title: Lecture 1
modules.subtitle: algorithm analysis: basic operations, counting, order of growth, big-O
modules.description: Textbook 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1. What an algorithm is, find and fib, counting statements and basic operations with the tie-breakers, setting up sums, best/worst case, orders of growth and Big-O / Ω / Θ. Every slide algorithm and every quiz-style fragment runs in a per-line execution counter. Ends with the practice problems worked, Mock Quiz 1 and a study sheet.
